name: agent-delegation
description: Delegate bounded, general-purpose tasks between ACP-compatible agents through a shared local contract.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded tasks across local agent CLIs.
interface.longDescription: Adds a provider-neutral Skill for handing arbitrary bounded tasks between Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, zCode, OpenCode, and registered ACP agents through a pinned ACPX runtime.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $agent-delegation to hand this bounded task to the most suitable registered agent and return a receipt-backed result.
